headline: GM leans into electrification with the Grand Sport X: Review
summary: Earlier this year, Chevy announced the Grand Sport would return to the Corvette lineup, and that's another good piece of news for General Motors' (GM) halo car that's doing well at the moment, with Corvette sales up about 24% in Q2.
